title: Wear OS collector to send data to NightScout
symptom: On Wear OS watches without Google services (e.g., Xiaomi Mi Watch), xDrip standalone collector works but there is no option to send readings to NightScout (Nightscout Uploader) from the watch.
evidence_quote: Would be great to have an option to send readings to NightScout from WearOS collector in case Google services are missing.
